notes: Only requirements present in all four claude_ablation raw directories and in claude experiment_runs.jsonl are included.
The claude baseline is restricted to the 10 requirements used by the ablation study, with 3 repeats per requirement.
Raw output-level values are retained as raw_compilation_success, raw_execution_success, and raw_combination_success; unavailable or unreadable raw values remain null.

Effectiveness fields are conservative booleans: compilation_success is true only when raw_compilation_success is true; execution_success is true only when compilation_success and raw_execution_success are true; combination_success is true only when execution_success and raw_combination_success are true.
raw_null_counts reports how many raw values were null for each variant and metric over the included 30 runs.
No aggregate mean is reported; requirement-level pass@k is computed directly from boolean pass/fail values.
Statistical tests compare QPipe against each ablation using requirement-level pass@1 samples.
"# of valid solution" is requirement-level and follows the RQ2 alignment rule: 1 when a QRR can be computed for the requirement, otherwise 0.
QRR follows the RQ2 reduction-rate formula and repeat alignment: (Q_GA - Q_LLM) / |Q_GA| using the preferred repeat for the problem type, falling back to the first valid aligned pair.
